_conforms_to.spec: TMF921 Intent Management API envelope with dispatch_result. Standalone extract of the companion_intent nested field from this scenario's remediation_proposal.json, exposed as a fixture so the documentation can reference it directly. The dispatch_result records the SMO's rejection.
_conforms_to.spec_section: Intent expression between Intent Owner and Intent Handler plus dispatch_result extension

rationale: Firmware update via Metal3 requires host reboot; the partner SMO is notified in parallel so it can pre-handover cells and gate downstream alarms during the maintenance window.

dispatch_result.smo_response: Cannot handover 47 UEs from worker-ran-03 cells; neighboring cells are at 92% capacity in the proposed window. Partner SMO recommends deferring the maintenance window by 4 hours or accepting SLA degradation during the apply.
